title: bruh.
note: An anime London rider on a lime green e-bike, turning a full circle behind and through the word bruh, dithered like an old screen.
process: [[Flora: Nano Banana Pro]] designed the character, an anime London youth in a colour-blocked hoodie on a lime green rental e-bike, as a 3D render, then put them on flat magenta. [[Flora: Kling v4]] turned that into a 10 second 360 degree turntable that ends where it starts. [[Claude Code]] keys the rider out of the magenta in a [[WebGL]] shader, sets bruh in [[Google Fonts]] Unbounded behind them with a hairline outline in front, and dithers the whole poster against a Bayer matrix shifted per colour channel, coarse on the background and fine on the rider.
